ios.desc:
Experience Pro-Level Nutrition Tracking with OpenNutrition. Unlock powerful adaptive macronutrient planning, comprehensive micronutrient logging, and intelligent AI-powered food search. These advanced tools are available to all users, with no subscription required. OpenNutrition is your smart macro tracker and AI diet coach, designed to help you lose fat, build muscle, and achieve your fitness goals with personalized, science-backed guidance.

OpenNutrition empowers you with precise and personalized nutritional insights. Log any meal effortlessly; our extensive, AI-verified database, advanced image recognition, and barcode scanning make it simple. For new or complex foods, let DeepSearch, our unique AI research feature, find comprehensive data.

With OpenNutrition, you can:

-  Set clear, personalized goals for weight management or muscle gain.
-  Receive dynamic macro recommendations tailored to your activity and preferences, or input your own for full control.
-  Easily log foods with a verified database, photo, barcode, and our advanced AI search, offering exceptional flexibility.
-  Track your complete nutritional intake, from detailed macronutrients to essential micronutrients, all within the core app.
-  Monitor your weight trends and progress with charts and insights that help you understand your body's responses.
-  Create and save custom recipes and meals for quick, accurate logging of your favorite dishes.

OpenNutrition helps you set realistic, achievable targets and respects your dietary choices without rigid rules. There’s no negative feedback for deviating from your plan; OpenNutrition adapts to support your lifestyle, keeping you motivated and on track towards your version of success.

Start your journey to more informed and effective nutrition tracking today. Download OpenNutrition and experience the difference.

show_hn.title: Show HN: OpenNutrition – A free, public nutrition database

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

Today I’m excited to launch OpenNutrition: a free, ODbL-licenced nutrition database of everyday generic, branded, and restaurant foods, a search engine that can browse the web to import new foods, and a companion app that bundles the database and search as a free macro tracking app.

Consistently logging the foods you eat has been shown to support long-term health outcomes (1)(2), but doing so easily depends on having a large, accurate, and up-to-date nutrition database. Free, public databases are often out-of-date, hard to navigate, and missing critical coverage (like branded restaurant foods). User-generated databases can be unreliable or closed-source. Commercial databases come with ongoing, often per-seat licensing costs, and usage restrictions that limit innovation.

As an amateur powerlifter and long-term weight loss maintainer, helping others pursue their health goals is something I care about deeply. After exiting my previous startup last year, I wanted to investigate the possibility of using LLMs to create the database and infrastructure required to make a great food logging app that was cost engineered for free and accessible distribution, as I believe that the availability of these tools is a public good. That led to creating the dataset I’m releasing today; nutritional data is public record, and its organization and dissemination should be, too.
